stories.title: SpaceXAI’s Grok programming tool was uploading its users’ entire codebase to cloud storage
stories.author: Stevie Bonifield
bullet_points: SpaceXAI's Grok Build AI coding tool was found to be uploading users' entire codebases to Google Cloud.
The tool was observed packaging and uploading entire code repositories, even files it was instructed to ignore.
The issue was reported by Cereblab, leading SpaceXAI to disable the Grok Build CLI.

stories.title: Meta accused of using biased AI targeting for mass layoffs
stories.author: Emma Roth
bullet_points: Meta is facing a lawsuit from 26 former employees regarding its layoff practices.
The core allegation is that Meta used internal AI tools to unfairly target specific workers for dismissal.
The lawsuit claims AI tools analyzed performance data to determine which employees were laid off.

stories.title: Microsoft’s Secure Boot has been broken for a decade and no one noticed until now
stories.author: Dan Goodin
bullet_points: Microsoft's Secure Boot implementation has a decade-long vulnerability.
The bypass is enabled by unrevoked, outdated 'shims' within the system.
This flaw allows for relatively simple circumvention of a core security feature.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights a trending model, deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1, on the Hugging Face platform.
The model is categorized for text generation and conversational AI tasks.
It utilizes standard ML components like transformers and safetensors.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of Meta-Llama-3-8B on Hugging Face.
It is categorized under text-generation pipelines, indicating its primary function as a large language model.
The associated tags (transformers, safetensors, llama) confirm its relevance within the modern NLP/AI ecosystem.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct model on Hugging Face.
The model is categorized under text-generation, indicating its primary function as a generative language model.
It is associated with key ML technologies like transformers and safetensors, placing it within the mainstream LLM ecosystem.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the 'deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro' model on Hugging Face.
The model is categorized for text generation tasks, indicating its primary function as a large language model (LLM).
It is associated with key ML technologies like transformers and safetensors, placing it within the current LLM ecosystem.

stories.title: Ollama: all aboard open models
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama, a platform for running open models, has secured significant funding.
The company raised $88 million from prominent investors including Y Combinator and Benchmark.
Ollama currently serves a substantial user base of 8.9 million developers.

stories.title: Faster Gemma 4 on MLX with multi-token prediction
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Gemma 4 inference speed is significantly improved in Ollama 0.31 on Apple Silicon.
The performance boost is achieved through the implementation of Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) powered by MLX.
Coding agent performance saw up to a 90% speed increase when benchmarked using Aider.

stories.title: Ollama's highest performance on Apple Silicon yet with MLX
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has achieved its peak performance on Apple Silicon.
The performance boost is attributed to updates in the MLX engine.
Improvements include faster response times, higher output quality, and reduced memory usage.

stories.title: OpenJarvis: a local-first personal AI is now available to run with Ollama
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: OpenJarvis v1.0 is released, providing an open-source framework for personal AI agents.
The key feature is the ability to run these AI agents locally on the user's own hardware.
It features built-in support for Ollama, leveraging local LLM execution.

stories.title: Ollama is now powered by MLX on Apple Silicon in preview
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama, a popular local LLM runner, is integrating MLX for performance gains.
This integration specifically targets Apple Silicon hardware for optimized AI inference.
The feature is currently available in a preview build, indicating active development.

stories.title: OpenClaw
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: OpenClaw is a personal AI assistant designed to integrate with messaging apps.
It connects these apps to local AI coding agents.
A key feature is that all AI processing runs entirely on the user's local device for privacy.

stories.title: OpenAI may announce a ChatGPT smart speaker this year
stories.author: Jay Peters
bullet_points: OpenAI is reportedly developing a dedicated smart speaker device powered by ChatGPT.
The device is expected to be screenless but will utilize a camera and sensors for environmental understanding.
The news surfaces shortly after Apple initiated a lawsuit against OpenAI.

stories.title: Lawsuit claims Meta's layoff decisions were made by AI, not humans
stories.author: Jon Brodkin
bullet_points: A lawsuit alleges that Meta utilized Artificial Intelligence in its layoff decisions.
The core of the legal challenge focuses on potential bias against workers with disabilities or medical issues.
Meta has officially denied the claim that AI was used to terminate employees based on these protected characteristics.

stories.title: New York bans data center construction for a year, rattling AI industry
stories.author: Ashley Belanger
bullet_points: New York has implemented a one-year moratorium on new data center construction.
This regulatory action is viewed as a potential precursor to broader anti-AI movements.
The ban directly impacts the infrastructure needs of the rapidly expanding AI industry.

stories.title: Inside the Unfair Judge: A Mechanistic Interpretability Account of LLM-as-Judge Bias
stories.author: Xiuying Chen
bullet_points: The research moves beyond surface-level input-output analysis of LLM-as-judge bias to investigate biases within the model's internal hidden states (representation-level account).
It provides a mechanistic interpretability framework to explain *why* LLMs exhibit judging biases, offering a deeper, complementary view to current methods.
The study is highly empirical, testing across seven judges, seven bias types, and nine benchmarks to validate its findings.

stories.title: Evidence-Backed Video Question Answering
stories.author: Juan Carlos Niebles
bullet_points: Proposes Evidence-Backed Video Question Answering (E-VQA) to address the black-box nature of current Video LLMs.
Current Video LLMs lack verifiable visual grounding for their textual answers, especially concerning complex dynamics like occlusions.
E-VQA requires models to jointly output a semantic answer alongside precise visual evidence.

stories.title: MM-ToolSandBox: A Unified Framework for Evaluating Visual Tool-Calling Agents
stories.author: Afshin Dehghan
bullet_points: Introduces MM-ToolSandBox, a new benchmark and evaluation framework specifically for visually grounded tool-calling agents.
The framework supports complex, stateful tasks involving 500+ tools across 16 application domains, handling multi-image and multi-turn interactions.
It tests agents' ability to manage realistic conversational challenges like goal revisions, error corrections, and state mutations during tool execution.

stories.title: Inside the Unfair Judge: A Mechanistic Interpretability Account of LLM-as-Judge Bias
stories.author: Xiuying Chen
bullet_points: The paper introduces a novel mechanistic interpretability approach to analyze bias in LLM-as-Judge systems.
It shifts the focus from input-output perturbations to analyzing biases within the judge's internal hidden state (representation-level account).
The research provides empirical evidence across multiple judges, bias types, and benchmarks, offering new avenues for bias mitigation.

stories.title: Inside the Unfair Judge: A Mechanistic Interpretability Account of LLM-as-Judge Bias
stories.author: Xiuying Chen
bullet_points: The paper moves beyond surface-level input-output analysis of LLM-as-Judge bias to investigate the underlying representation-level causes within the judge's hidden state.
It provides a mechanistic interpretability account of bias, offering a deeper, complementary understanding to existing perturbation-based studies.
The research is highly empirical, testing findings across seven judges, seven bias types, and nine benchmarks.

stories.title: Improved performance and model support with GGUF
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama 0.30 release introduces performance enhancements and expanded GGUF model compatibility.
The update leverages llama.cpp to broaden model support across various hardware configurations.
It enhances Ollama's MLX engine specifically for improved functionality on Apple silicon.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Introduction of NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra.
Designed specifically for high-throughput reasoning tasks.
Optimized for supporting long-running agent workflows.

stories.title: Subagents and web search in Claude Code
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has integrated support for subagents within Claude Code.
The new feature set includes the capability for web search functionality in Claude Code.
This update enhances the complexity and capability of AI agents running through Ollama.

stories.title: Boston Dynamics tries using ‘robot dogs’ for deliveries
stories.author: Andrew Liszewski
bullet_points: Boston Dynamics is expanding the use of its Spot robot beyond inspections and patrolling.
The company is testing a new conveyor belt accessory to enable package delivery.
The goal of this development is to allow Spot to autonomously unload packages at customer doorsteps.

stories.title: US military sent explosive drone boats into combat for the first time
stories.author: Jeremy Hsu
bullet_points: The US military has deployed explosive drone boats into combat operations.
These drone boats were used to strike an Iranian naval port.
The deployment occurs amid escalating tensions in the region.

stories.title: These painted e-tattoos could be the future of wearable biosensors
stories.author: Jennifer Ouellette
bullet_points: The article discusses the potential of painted e-tattoos as next-generation wearable biosensors.
These sensors utilize conductive ink applied directly to the skin to form functional electrodes.
This technology suggests a shift towards more aesthetically integrated and user-friendly health monitoring.

stories.title: Google revamps image search for its 25th anniversary with more images and more AI
stories.author: Ryan Whitwam
bullet_points: Google is updating its image search functionality for its 25th anniversary.
The revamp integrates AI to create an always-updated gallery based on user 'unique interests'.
This signals a continued push by Google to personalize and deepen AI integration across core services.

stories.title: SpaceX is gearing up for Starship's 13th test flight later this week
stories.author: Stephen Clark
bullet_points: SpaceX is preparing for the 13th test flight of the Starship vehicle.
The upcoming flight is designed to subject Starship to increased operational pressures.
The mission will also involve testing new Starlink satellites in orbit.

stories.title: Metacognition in LLMs: Foundations, Progress, and Opportunities
stories.author: Arman Cohan
bullet_points: Metacognition is identified as a crucial, foundational component for advanced intelligence in AI.
The paper addresses the current gap in understanding how and when Large Language Models (LLMs) can achieve effective metacognitive abilities.
The research highlights the need to explore how metacognitive skills can be adapted within AI systems for better performance.

stories.title: Invariant Learning Dynamics of Transformers in Inductive Reasoning Tasks
stories.author: Thomas Hofmann
bullet_points: Presents a theoretical framework to explain how Transformer models develop inductive reasoning abilities.
The research generalizes inductive tasks, unifying concepts like in-context n-grams and multi-hop reasoning.
The study theoretically proves that the training dynamics of attention models can be confined within a specific class of tasks.

stories.title: Transformer-Guided Swarm Intelligence for Frugal Neural Architecture Search
stories.author: Romain Amigon
bullet_points: Proposes a new, frugal Neural Architecture Search (NAS) framework to reduce computational costs.
Combines a Transformer controller (trained via RL) for global search with local micro-exploitation.
Aims to democratize model design by enabling NAS on consumer-grade hardware instead of requiring massive GPU clusters.

stories.title: Encoder-Side Neuron Identification and Amplification for Acoustic Perception in Large Audio-Language Models
stories.author: Hung-yi Lee
bullet_points: Addresses the limitation of Large Audio-Language Models (LALMs) in capturing fine-grained speech attributes like emotion.
Proposes an inference-time intervention method focused on the audio encoder, rather than post-encoding processing.
Aims to enhance acoustic perception without the computational cost of full model retraining.

stories.title: Requential Coding: Pushing the Limits of Model Compression with Self-Generated Training Data
stories.author: Andrew Gordon Wilson
bullet_points: The paper introduces 'Prequential Coding' as a novel approach to model compression.
It addresses a limitation of traditional methods (like quantization) where code length scales with model size, regardless of actual information stored.
The core idea is that a model's ability to represent training data as a short code indicates discovered regularities crucial for generalization.

stories.title: Invariant Learning Dynamics of Transformers in Inductive Reasoning Tasks
stories.author: Thomas Hofmann
bullet_points: Presents a theoretical framework to explain how Transformer models develop inductive reasoning abilities.
Studies a generalized class of inductive tasks, unifying concepts like in-context n-grams and multi-hop reasoning.
The research theoretically proves that the training dynamics of attention models can be constrained within this generalized task class.

stories.title: A Minimalist Retargeting-Guided Reinforcement Learning Recipe for Dexterous Manipulation
stories.author: Preston Culbertson
bullet_points: Introduces REGRIND, a new minimalist pipeline for dexterous manipulation.
Addresses the challenge of applying simple motion retargeting recipes to complex, contact-rich manipulation tasks.
Utilizes Reinforcement Learning (RL) guided by motion retargeting to achieve delicate control over contact modes and forces.

stories.title: Input-Aware Dynamic Backdoor Attack Against Quantum Neural Networks
stories.author: Rui Ning
bullet_points: The research addresses security vulnerabilities in Quantum Neural Networks (QNNs), a promising area for quantum machine learning.
It introduces a novel 'Input-Aware Dynamic Backdoor Attack,' moving beyond traditional fixed-trigger backdoor methods.
This dynamic approach is designed to circumvent existing defenses that target repetitive patterns left by static triggers.

stories.title: Transformer-Guided Swarm Intelligence for Frugal Neural Architecture Search
stories.author: Romain Amigon
bullet_points: Proposes a new, frugal Neural Architecture Search (NAS) framework to reduce computational costs.
Combines a Transformer controller (trained via RL) for global search with local micro-exploitation.
Aims to democratize model design by enabling NAS on consumer-grade hardware instead of requiring massive GPU clusters.

stories.title: Metacognition in LLMs: Foundations, Progress, and Opportunities
stories.author: Arman Cohan
bullet_points: The paper addresses metacognition, a key component of intelligence, in the context of Large Language Models (LLMs).
It highlights that while LLMs show progress in various tasks, their capacity for effective metacognition remains unclear.
The research points to the need to understand how and when LLMs can be endowed with or exhibit metacognitive abilities.

stories.title: AdvancedMathBench: A Benchmark Suite for Advanced Mathematical Proof Generation and Verification
stories.author: Kai Chen
bullet_points: Introduces AdvancedMathBench, a new benchmark suite designed to test LLMs on advanced mathematical proof generation and verification.
Addresses the current gap where existing benchmarks fail to adequately assess the validity of reasoning processes in complex math problems.
Aims to push the boundaries of LLM capabilities beyond high-school/Olympiad level mathematics into more advanced domains.

stories.title: How Temperature Shapes Ideological Discourse in Retrieval-Augmented Generation?
stories.author: Anderson Avila
bullet_points: The research investigates how 'Temperature' settings influence ideological discourse within Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) models.
It addresses a gap in current LLM research by focusing on the impact of ideological bias transmitted through retrieved documents.
The study examines whether RAG systems amplify, transmit, or suppress existing ideological positions found in the source material.

stories.title: MET: Theory-Grounded and Culture-Aware Multilingual Moral Reasoning
stories.author: Lu Wang
bullet_points: Addresses limitations in current language models for multilingual moral reasoning.
Identifies issues with current benchmarks (relying on direct translation) and inference methods (static, English-centric scaffolds).
Proposes addressing the need for theory-grounded and culture-aware training methods.

stories.title: STEP: Career-Path Recommendation via Temporal and Educational Trajectory Modeling
stories.author: Tijl De Bie
bullet_points: The research proposes 'STEP' to recommend career paths by modeling temporal and educational trajectories from resumes.
It addresses the challenge of analyzing resumes at scale due to their unstructured, heterogeneous, and multilingual nature.
The work leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) to enable systematic analysis for workforce planning and job recommendations.

stories.title: Bonsai 27B: A 27B-Class model that runs on a phone
stories.author: xenova
bullet_points: Introduction of 'Bonsai 27B', a new 27-billion parameter model.
Key feature is its ability to run inference directly on a mobile phone.
This suggests significant progress in model quantization and on-device AI capabilities.

stories.title: Observability Design for the AI Era — Reconciling PII Protection With AI Searchability, and Driving Self-Healing (Part 2)
stories.author: ryantsuji
bullet_points: Addresses the complex challenge of maintaining PII protection while enabling AI searchability in observability systems.
Proposes a multi-layer design utilizing consistent hashing at both write and search times for data privacy.
Connects observability data flow (from CI failure to PR proposal) to driving automated Self-Healing capabilities.

stories.title: I Put a Hailo 8 in a Handheld and Stopped Paying for Inference
stories.author: numbpill3d
bullet_points: The article discusses the shift from cloud-based AI inference to on-device processing.
The author successfully integrated a Hailo 8 accelerator into a handheld device.
The core theme is challenging the subscription model of cloud AI services by enabling local, cost-effective inference.

stories.title: Your RAG Eval Isn't Flaky. Your Retrieval Is Non-Deterministic.
stories.author: mrviduus
bullet_points: The article addresses non-deterministic behavior in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) evaluation.
It suggests that perceived 'flakiness' in RAG evaluations might stem from issues in the retrieval component, not the evaluation itself.
This highlights a critical, practical challenge in deploying and debugging production-grade RAG systems.

stories.title: DiffusionGemma: 4x faster text generation
stories.author: geminiteam
bullet_points: Introduction of 'DiffusionGemma,' a new open experimental model.
The model demonstrates up to 4x faster inference speed.
Performance gains are specifically noted when running on dedicated GPUs.
